g.text: Human-rooted cladograms of 957 PIF1-family proteins; tips coloured by paralog (Pif1 vs Rrm3 daughter clade). Adding the 3Di structural alphabet collapses the Pif1/Rrm3 duplication from the base of Fungi to Saccharomycotina.
